upstream_tag_sha__command: json=$(cat meta.json) && upstream_image=$(jq -re '.upstream_image' <<< "${json}") && upstream_image_base=$(basename "${upstream_image}") && upstream_tag=$(jq -re '.upstream_tag' <<< "${json}") && tags_json=$(curl -fsSL ${GITHUB_TOKEN:+--header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"} "https://hotio.dev/containers/${upstream_image_base}-tags.json") && commit_sha=$(jq -r --arg tag "${upstream_tag}" '.[$tag].commit_sha' <<< "${tags_json}") && upstream_tag_sha=${upstream_tag}-${commit_sha:0:7} && echo "${upstream_tag_sha}"
version__command: if ! test -f cache-page1.json; then curl -fsSL ${GITHUB_TOKEN:+--header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"} "https://api.github.com/repos/Tautulli/Tautulli/releases/latest" > cache-page1.json; fi && cat cache-page1.json | jq -re '.tag_name' | sed -E 's/^v//'
version_branch__command: if ! test -f cache-page1.json; then curl -fsSL ${GITHUB_TOKEN:+--header "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"} "https://api.github.com/repos/Tautulli/Tautulli/releases/latest" > cache-page1.json; fi && prerelease=$(cat cache-page1.json | jq -r '.prerelease') && if [[ ${prerelease} == true ]]; then version_branch="beta"; else version_branch="master"; fi && echo "${version_branch}"
